reason: The resolved-rules journal retires the action-scoped commands (stack push/removal, trigger collection, non-leave zone changes and the other kinds read only by cast-scoped classification) that each committed repetition of a taken loop shortcut records, so GameState.resolved_rules_journal command ordinals may now skip. An older peer's load validator requires contiguous ordinals and rejects such a journal as invalid. Full-game peers and P2P move in lockstep; no lobby carrier names it.
